# FreeAudioBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeAudioBus:Void bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus). `0` (the master bus) is ignored, anything else that is not a bus is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Frees a bus. Its channels, the buses that feed it, the sounds that [SoundBus](SoundBus) put on it and [MusicBus](MusicBus) go to the bus it fed, and play on without a gap. Its [effects](AddAudioEffect) are freed with it. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
FreeAudioBus cave
```
